phase_boundary: After Llama internal collection and Qwen internal collection; before GLM internal collection, all RAG collection, all Stage 5 calls, and any held-out accuracy evaluation.

trigger.observation: The initial response and both pre-frozen format-only retries reached finish_reason=length without a valid six-field JSON object.

change.scope: All locked internal-endpoint calls; successful calls are unchanged and remain cached.
change.retry_semantics: The existing format-repair function is used unchanged. Model, claim, seeds, decoding parameters, response contract, and substantive task prompt are unchanged. Failed attempts remain immutable and auditable.

prohibited_changes: No partial or malformed verdict may be parsed or imputed.
No gold label may be consulted.
No model-specific decision rule or evaluation gate may change.
No further amendment is implied if the additional retry fails.
rationale: This is a bounded data-validity recovery decided solely from the provider termination state and contract validity, before outcome evaluation. It prevents silent endpoint fabrication or post-label sample exclusion.
